name: malformed-top-level-shape-array-not-object
description: A response body whose root is a JSON array (not an object) is rejected outright.

name: bridge-change-missing-record-id
description: A bridge_changes entry with no record_id is rejected.

name: bridge-change-non-string-record-id
description: A bridge_changes entry whose record_id is a number, not a string, is rejected.

name: bridge-change-invalid-change-type
description: A change_type outside the closed { create, update, delete } vocabulary is rejected.

name: bridge-change-missing-timestamp
description: A bridge_changes entry with no timestamp is rejected.

name: bridge-change-snapshot-non-string-id
description: A snapshot whose id is a number, not a string, is rejected -- WireAnimeSchema requires a string id.

name: bridge-change-snapshot-non-string-name
description: A snapshot whose name is a number, not a string, is rejected.

name: bridge-change-snapshot-missing-required-scalar
description: A snapshot missing a required scalar (firstCycle) is rejected, even with modified_at present.

name: bridge-change-snapshot-not-an-object
description: A present-but-non-object snapshot (a bare array) is rejected.

name: applied-operation-missing-anime-id
description: An applied_operations entry with no anime_id is rejected.

name: applied-operation-missing-operation
description: An applied_operations entry with no operation is rejected.
